title: Systemic and structural barriers to integration and release following forensic psychiatric hospitalization in accordance with the German Criminal Code
summary:
The legally prescribed goal of forensic psychiatric treatment according to Section 63 of the German Criminal Code (StGB) is for the person to lead a life free of crime after their release. The person should therefore be reintegrated into society. In order for this reintegration to be successful in the long term, patients and their forensic caregivers often rely on cooperation with aftercare and other rehabilitation-oriented institutions outside the forensic system. This applies to the areas of health care, housing and work. Aftercare institutions include, for example, social psychiatric services or providers or operators of outpatient psychiatric or psychotherapeutic care services, residential homes or assisted living facilities, workshops for people with disabilities, and other work-related rehabilitation measures. 
At the same time, the results of various studies suggest that forensic authorities often find it difficult to design or find suitable release settings with the involvement of external partners.

The project aims to identify systemic and structrural barriers to integration and release, and to quantify the impact on prolonged length of stay. Therefor it encompasses several parts an applies various methods. Results are thought to provide better transitions from forensic psychiatry to aftercare institutions, and to avoid prolonged lengths of stay.

interventions.name: I Qualitative interviews (Subproject C and D): Subproject C involves guided interviews with (former) patients who are or were institutionalized in accordance with Section 63 of the German Criminal Code (StGB). In subproject D, guided interviews are conducted with employees of non-forensic institutio

II Quantitative personal interrogation via telephone (Subproject B)  of practitioners who treat or have treated patients who are or were institutionalized pursuant to Section 63 of the German Criminal Code (StGB).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Subproject B1: Forensic-psychiatric treatment acc. to Sec. 63 StGB and release into freedom between 08/01/2024 and 08/31/25

Subproject B2: Current forensic-psychiatric treatment acc. to Sec. 63 StGB on 09/01/2025

Subproject C: Current forensic-psychiatric treatment acc. to Sec. 63 StGB on 09/01/2025 or forensic-psychiatric treatment acc. to Sec. 63 StGB and release into freedom between 08/01/2024 and 08/31/25

Subproject D: Employment in an aftercare institution
Exclusion criteria:
Subproject B: None
Subproject C and D: Lack of ability to consent
